intent.one_liner: Query: Current stock on hand by warehouse
intent.brief: Shows the current stock position — on hand, reserved and available units — for a product at each of the three warehouses, together with when that position was last updated. Users pick a product either by exact SKU or by product series, and can narrow it to one warehouse. This is the latest snapshot only; it carries no history.

sql: SELECT p.sku AS product_sku, p.name AS product_name, i.warehouse AS warehouse_name, i.on_hand_qty AS on_hand_units, i.reserved_qty AS reserved_units, (i.on_hand_qty - i.reserved_qty) AS available_units, i.updated_at AS stock_updated_at FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.id WHERE p.sku = 'HC-300' AND p.series IN ('ACC', 'EMS', 'HC', 'INV') AND i.warehouse IN ('Brisbane', 'Melbourne', 'Sydney') ORDER BY p.sku, i.warehouse LIMIT 50

filters.hint: Exact-match filter on the product SKU (examples in this catalogue: HC-215, HC-300, INV-50K, INV-110K, EMS-PRO, ACC-RACK). Set it to the SKU the user names, verbatim and uppercase. This is an exact match — a partial code or a product name will not match, so if the user names a product without giving a SKU, use the series filter instead and DISABLE this one. DEFAULT: keep HC-300 when no product is named. DISABLE: whenever the user asks about a whole series or about all products rather than one SKU.

Restricts which product series are included. Allowed values ONLY: HC (battery cabinets), INV (inverters), EMS (energy management software), ACC (accessories). Use this when the user names a family rather than a SKU ("how much HC stock do we have") and disable the SKU filter in the same breath. DEFAULT: keep all four values. DISABLE: not needed — all four values already means no restriction.

Restricts which warehouses are shown. Allowed values ONLY (match this capitalisation): Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane. Map "in Sydney", "the Melbourne DC", "east coast except Brisbane" to the matching subset; reject any other location. DEFAULT: keep all three, which shows the full national picture. DISABLE: not needed.

outputs.hint: Output: the product code. Keep by default; drop only if the user asks for fewer columns.
Output: the product's commercial name. Keep by default; safe to drop on request.
Output: which warehouse the row describes. Keep it whenever more than one warehouse can appear, otherwise the numbers cannot be told apart.
Output: physical units sitting in that warehouse. Keep it — it is the point of the query.
Output: units already committed to orders and therefore not sellable. Keep by default; drop if the user only wants the headline on-hand number.
Output: on hand minus reserved — what can actually be promised to a new order. Keep by default; this is usually the number the user means by "available".
Output: when this stock position was last refreshed. Keep by default so the reader knows how fresh the snapshot is; safe to drop.
